arxiv-1312-6265.title: Paley type inequality of the Fourier transform on the Heisenberg group
arxiv-1312-6265.creator: Atef Rahmouni
arxiv-1312-6265.description:
A 2013 arXiv research paper by Atef Rahmouni. A paley type inequality for the Fourier transform on H p ​ ( ℍ n ) , H^{p}(\mathbb{H}^{n}), the Hardy space on the Heisenberg group, is obtained for 0 < p ≤ 1 . Introduction

The study of Hardy spaces has been originated during the 1910’s
in the setting of Fourier series and complex analysis in one
variable.

arxiv-1704-02149.title: Dark matter self-interactions from a general spin-0 mediator
arxiv-1704-02149.creator: Felix Kahlhoefer, Kai Schmidt-Hoberg, and Sebastian Wild
arxiv-1704-02149.description: Abstract Dark matter particles interacting via the exchange of very light spin-0 mediators can have large self-interaction rates and obtain their relic abundance from thermal freeze-out. At the same time, these models face strong bounds from direct and indirect probes of dark matter as well as a number of constraints on the properties of the mediator.

arxiv-2012-08935.title: A new complemented subspace for the Lorentz sequence spaces, with an application to its lattice of closed ideals
arxiv-2012-08935.creator: Ben Wallis
arxiv-2012-08935.description: Abstract . We show that every Lorentz sequence space d ⁡ ( w , p ) d(\textbf{w},p) admits a 1-complemented subspace Y Y distinct from ℓ p \ell_{p} and containing no isomorph of d ⁡ ( w , p ) d(\textbf{w},p) .

arxiv-2107-04136.title: Diagonal nonlinear transformations preserve structure in covariance and precision matrices
arxiv-2107-04136.creator: Rebecca E. Morrison, Ricardo Baptista, Estelle L. Basor
arxiv-2107-04136.description: Abstract . For a multivariate normal distribution, the sparsity of the covariance and precision matrices encodes complete information about independence and conditional independence properties. For general distributions, the covariance and precision matrices reveal correlations and so-called partial correlations between variables, but these do not, in general, have any correspondence with respect to independence properties.

arxiv-2112-09634.title: On extension of the data driven ROM inverse scattering framework to partially nonreciprocal arrays
arxiv-2112-09634.creator: V. Druskin, S. Moskow and M. Zaslavsky
arxiv-2112-09634.description: Abstract Data-driven reduced order models (ROMs) recently emerged as powerful tool for the solution of inverse scattering problems. The main drawback of this approach is that it was limited to the measurement arrays with reciprocally collocated transmitters and receivers, that is, square symmetric matrix (data) transfer functions.

arxiv-2209-15548.title: The Roasting Marshmallows Program with IGRINS on Gemini South I: Composition and Climate of the Ultra Hot Jupiter WASP-18 b Facilities: Gemini-South (IGRINS) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , barycorrpy ( Kanodia & Wright 2018 ) , corner ( Foreman-Mackey 2016 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 20
arxiv-2209-15548.creator: Matteo Brogi, Vanessa Emeka-Okafor, Michael R. Line, Siddharth Gandhi, Lorenzo Pino, Eliza M.-R. Kempton, Emily Rauscher, Vivien Parmentier, Jacob L. Bean, Gregory N. Mace, Nicolas B. Cowan, Evgenya Shkolnik, Joost P. Wardenier, Megan Mansfield, Luis Welbanks, Peter Smith, Jonathan J. Fortney, Jayne
arxiv-2209-15548.description: Abstract We present high-resolution dayside thermal emission observations of the exoplanet WASP-18 b using IGRINS on Gemini South. We remove stellar and telluric signatures using standard algorithms, and we extract the planet signal via cross correlation with model spectra. We detect the atmosphere of WASP-18 b at a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 5.

arxiv-2301-01441.title: Automatically Prepare Training Data for YOLO Using Robotic In-Hand Observation and Synthesis
arxiv-2301-01441.creator: Hao Chen, Weiwei Wan, Masaki Matsushita, Takeyuki Kotaka, Kensuke Harada
arxiv-2301-01441.description: Abstract Deep learning methods have recently exhibited impressive performance in object detection. However, such methods needed much training data to achieve high recognition accuracy, which was time-consuming and required considerable manual work like labeling images. In this paper, we automatically prepare training data using robots.

arxiv-2303-01155.title: Marker-based Visual SLAM leveraging Hierarchical Representations
arxiv-2303-01155.creator: Ali Tourani, Hriday Bavle, Jose Luis Sanchez-Lopez, Rafael Muñoz Salinas, Holger Voos
arxiv-2303-01155.description: Abstract Fiducial markers can encode rich information about the environment and can aid VSLAM ( VSLAM ) approaches in reconstructing maps with practical semantic information. Current marker-based VSLAM approaches mainly utilize markers for improving feature detections in low-feature environments and/or for incorporating loop closure constraints, generating only low-level geometric maps of the environment prone to inaccuracies in complex environments.

arxiv-2412-18361.title: On a generalized Monge-Ampère equation on closed almost Kähler surfaces Thanks: Supported by NSFC Grants 1197112 Thanks: Supported by NSFC Grants 12371078 Thanks: Supported by NSFC Grants 12171417
arxiv-2412-18361.creator: Ken Wang, Zuyi Zhang, Tao Zheng, Peng Zhu
arxiv-2412-18361.description: Abstract . We show the existence and uniqueness of solutions to a generalized Monge-Ampère equation on closed almost Kähler surfaces, where the equation depends only on the underlying almost Kähler structure. As an application, we prove Donaldson’s conjecture for tamed almost complex 4-manifolds. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 53D35;53C56,53C65;32Q60 1.

arxiv-2502-17410.title: COSMOS: A Hybrid Adaptive Optimizer for Memory-Efficient Training of LLMs Thanks: 1 Georgia Tech, 2 Microsoft. Correspondence to lliu606, zhenghaoxu,zzhang3105,tourzhao@gatech.edu
arxiv-2502-17410.creator: Liming Liu Zhenghao Xu Zixuan Zhang Hao Kang, Zichong Li Chen Liang Weizhu Chen Tuo Zhao
arxiv-2502-17410.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success across various domains, yet their optimization remains a significant challenge due to the complex and high-dimensional loss landscapes they inhabit. While adaptive optimizers such as AdamW are widely used, they suffer from critical limitations, including an inability to capture interdependencies between coordinates and high memory consumption.

arxiv-2508-07729.title: Uniform rationality of products with the plane
arxiv-2508-07729.creator: Juliusz Banecki
arxiv-2508-07729.description: Abstract Let X X be a nonsingular rational variety. We prove that X × ℂ 2 X\times\mathbb{C}^{2} is uniformly rational. It follows that nonsingular stably rational varieties are stably uniformly rational. 1 Introduction Throughout the paper, the term variety refers to a quasi-projective variety over \mathbb{C} , i.e. an irreducible Zariski locally closed subset of a projective space \mathbb{P}_{\mathbb{C}}^{n} .

arxiv-2601-08814.title: Positive Lyapunov Exponents versus Integrability in Random Conservative Dynamics
arxiv-2601-08814.creator: Gianluigi Del Magno, João Lopes Dias, José Pedro Gaivão
arxiv-2601-08814.description: Abstract . We study random dynamical systems generated by volume-preserving piecewise C 1 C^{1} maps. For this class of systems, we establish an invariance principle stating that if all Lyapunov exponents vanish, then there exists a measurable family of probability measures on the projective bundle that is invariant under the projective cocycle induced by the derivative.

arxiv-2602-16366.title: Global Gevrey Hypoellipticity of Involutive Systems on Non-Compact Manifolds
arxiv-2602-16366.creator: Sandro Coriasco, Alexandre Kirilov, Wagner A. A. de Moraes, Pedro M. Tokoro
arxiv-2602-16366.description: Abstract . We investigate the global Gevrey hypoellipticity of a class of first-order differential operators associated with tube-type involutive structures on M × 𝕋 m M\times\mathbb{T}^{m} , where M M is a non-compact manifold diffeomorphic to the interior of a compact manifold with boundary and 𝕋 m \mathbb{T}^{m} is the m m -dimensional torus.

pmc-12634999.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ca2+ Channel α2δ Ligands for the Treatment of Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathic Pain: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis
pmc-12634999.creator: Hui Guo, Yi Wang, Hongjun Lv, Bingyin Shi
pmc-12634999.description: IntroductionDiabetic peripheral neuropathic pain (DPNP), a chronic complication of diabetes mellitus that impacts quality of life, is treated with Ca2⁺ channel α2δ ligands such as mirogabalin (MGB), pregabalin (PGB), and gabapentin (GBP), which are recommended as first-line treatments. However, direct comparative evidence among 3 Ca2⁺ channel α2δ ligands efficacy and safety remain limited.

pmc-13185252.title: Genomic signatures of population isolation in an endangered European rodent
pmc-13185252.creator: Paige A. Byerly, Alina von Thaden, Gregor Rolshausen, Berardino Cocchiararo, Stefanie Erhardt, Joanna Fietz, Alain C. Frantz, Eva Marie Kramer, Sarah P. Stubbe, Lorenzo Vinciguerra, Sven Winter, Johannes Lang, Holger Meinig, Sven Büchner, Carsten Nowak
pmc-13185252.description: BackgroundThe garden dormouse (Eliomys quercinus) is one of the fastest-declining mammals in Europe, and action is needed to prevent further population losses. The primary causes of declines are not well-understood, as the species experiences variable conditions and threats across its range, but likely include habitat fragmentation and loss.

pmc-13695465.title: Exploring the efficacy and safety of perampanel in epilepsia partialis continua: A case series
pmc-13695465.creator: Setareh Lahsaee, Kristin M Ikeda, Stephanie Woodroffe, Benjamin P Whatley
pmc-13695465.description: BackgroundEpilepsia partialis continua (EPC) is a form of focal motor status epilepticus (SE), which is commonly drug‐resistant requiring treatment with multiple antiseizure medications (ASM). There are no established guidelines for pharmacological management. Perampanel (PER), an AMPA receptor antagonist, has gained attention in treating SE based on limited case reports. This study evaluates the efficacy of PER in treating EPC.
